data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Gutenberg search for author and downloads, IMDb search for year and rating, then the Notes entry in the same format) with book_title as the parameter, but the extra film_choice parameter is vague, since the true workflow always takes the first adaptation, and a few UI details like the cookie prompt and select-all are added.
